# Linespedia - AI-Friendly Content Index
# https://library.linespedia.com

> Linespedia is a curated archive of shayari, poems, quotes, and poetic lines with meanings, translations, and attribution.

## Site Structure

- `/` - Homepage with featured poems, writers, categories, and collections
- `/line/{slug}/` - Individual poem/line pages with content, meaning, author, and related lines
- `/line/ap/{writer}/{poem}/` - AllPoetry-sourced poem pages
- `/{writer-slug}/` - Writer/poet profile pages with bibliography
- `/{category-slug}/` - Category pages (e.g., /sad-shayari/, /love-poetry/, /deep-lines/)
- `/{collection-slug}/` - Curated collection pages
- `/blog/` - Poetry guides, literary analysis, and educational articles
- `/explore/` - Browse and search all content
- `/categories/` - All categories index
- `/writers/` - All writers index
- `/collections/` - All collections index
- `/api/` - REST API for accessing poetry content programmatically
- `/posters/` - Downloadable quote poster gallery
- `/sponsor/` - Sponsorship and advertising information
- `/about/` - About Linespedia
- `/contact/` - Contact information
- `/privacy/` - Privacy policy
- `/terms/` - Terms of service
- `/copyright/` - Copyright and attribution policy
- `/submit/` - Submit your own lines/poems

## Content Types

1. **Poems/Lines**: Individual poetic lines with full text, meaning/context, author attribution, source, categories, and related lines
2. **Writer Profiles**: Poet/author pages with biography, bibliography, and related content
3. **Categories**: Thematic groupings (sad shayari, love poetry, nature poetry, deep lines, etc.)
4. **Collections**: Curated selections for specific moods, occasions, or platforms
5. **Blog Articles**: Educational content about poetry, literary analysis, writing guides

## Data Sources

- Public domain poetry (Shakespeare, Dickinson, Whitman, Poe, etc.)
- Curated content with proper attribution
- User-submitted content (moderated)

## API Access

REST API available at `/api/v1/` with endpoints for random poems, search, categories, and writers. Documentation at `/api/docs/`.
